source_style: existing supplied dungeon and character sprite packs, reinterpreted as original retro-pixel art
background: Foundation-only 1440x940 top-down infernal basalt arena with dark violet stone, ember seams, open lanes, and no runtime objects.
dressed_reference: Same arena framing with sparse natural basalt obstacles, rubble, braziers, vents, and central demonic altar; no annotations.

character_actions.idle: 2x2 four-frame grounded idle sheet; central safe area, stable feet anchor, pure magenta background.
character_actions.walk: 2x3 six-frame grounded walk sheet; stable camera, scale, and feet anchor, pure magenta background.
character_actions.attack: 2x2 four-frame compact attack sheet; body action only where possible, pure magenta background.
character_actions.hurt: 2x2 four-frame readable hurt/recoil sheet, pure magenta background.
character_actions.death: 2x3 six-frame death sheet with readable collapse and stable root, pure magenta background.

processing: Generated raw sheets were chroma-keyed, frame-extracted, aligned, and QC-checked with the generate2dsprite and generate2dmap processors.
